role: The abstract NBT tag base: the 12 type ids, the factory that builds an empty tag of a type, and the write/read/copy/equals contract every tag implements.
scope_reason: NBT carries every snapshot file, every entity and tile-entity digest (d.ents) and every item tag; the native engine cannot load or digest state without it.

members.name: NBTTypes
members.note: The native enum holds the same 12 kinds in id order; the name strings themselves are only crash-report text and are not ported.

members.name: write
members.note: The abstract writer, implemented per kind; the binary form is checked byte for byte by the d.ents SHA-1 digest on replayed tapes.

members.name: func_152446_a
members.note: The abstract reader, implemented per kind; region.c reads the tag kinds a chunk's Level compound carries.

members.name: toString
members.note: The native counterpart is the canonical text form (typed scalars, keys sorted), used for the same debug-and-compare purpose, not Java's printed format.

members.name: func_150284_a
members.note: The type-id dispatch: region.c builds the matching native node from the type byte; an unknown type fails the load where Java returns null.

members.name: copy
members.note: Deep copy through the canonical text round trip (render then parse), which is lossless for every tree the game produces; a string a canonical text cannot carry back is refused rather than dropped.

members.name: equals
members.note: Type id plus value comparison; nbt_diff walks two trees field by field and names the first differing path.

members.name: hashCode
members.note: Only feeds Java's HashMap; the native writer reproduces the HashMap iteration order structurally from insertion order (nbtbin.c), so no hash is needed.

members.name: func_150285_a_
members.note: the base string value (toString) is reached only by NBTTagCompound.getString on a non-string tag and NBTTagList.getStringTagAt's non-string branch; NBTTagString overrides it, and the game reads every string key it wrote as a string

notes: The nested abstract class NBTPrimitive (the scalar-tag supertype with the func_1502xx cross-type getters) is the NBT_BYTE..NBT_DOUBLE range of nbt_type in csrc/engine/nbtjson.h; its per-class records carry those getters. The write path (nbtbin.c) is proven by the whole-tape replay gates with d.ents compared; the read path (region.c) by chunk loads; the canonical round trip by test_snapshots.c step 3.
